dependencyCoverage: All 347 source Cargo.lock entries with registry checksums, including build/dev/other-target entries; closed conservative superset. Release workflow runs cargo build against the tagged checkout; it does not specify --locked. No independent build attestation is available.
binaryProvenance: Managed runtime uses the digest-verified official v0.1.4 Linux asset, not the existing Cargo-installed binary whose installation receipt omits dependency resolution. Tag, crates.io trusted-publishing SHA and local registry VCS metadata agree on resolvedCommit. Digest verification is not reproducible-build verification.
scope: global runtime, moodle-reader-only tool access via the moodle skill
namespaceOverride: User explicitly requested MCP key moodle; runtime retains vendor-g36maid namespace.
backupPath: Original ~/.cargo/bin/moodle-mcp retained; no previous managed runtime.

securityReview.scope: Startup/config, fixed REST client, whoami/course/assignment/grades/schedule read paths, tool disabling/dispatch, release workflow and tagged dependency pins; launcher integrity/env isolation.
controls: File fetching/conversion/downloads and additional unapproved tools removed from server router

limitations: Redirect confinement in upstream checks hostname, not full origin/scheme/port; fixed trusted site is required
No fresh registry vulnerability scan, reproducible-build verification or exact feature-pruned build graph verification performed
Dependency evidence pins the full source lockfile superset rather than proving every compiled crate from the binary
